meta.title: How dependent is each Malaysian state on tourism?
meta.subtitle: Domestic tourism receipts as % of state GDP
meta.metric: Domestic tourism receipts (RM) divided by nominal state GDP (RM), 2024
meta.status: Final — all figures verified against DOSM primary sources (GDP by State 2024; Domestic Tourism Survey States 2024). Receipts sum to RM106.7b, matching the published national total.
caveats: DOMESTIC tourism only. Malaysia does not publish international tourism receipts by state; international arrivals are counted by entry point, not destination state. This is therefore NOT comparable to the country-level 'international tourism receipts as % of GDP' chart.
DERIVED ratio. DOSM does not publish this percentage directly; it is computed here as domestic tourism receipts divided by nominal state GDP, both for 2024.
Numerator (receipts) and denominator (GDP) come from two different DOSM products; treat the ratio as indicative, not an official statistic.

Putrajaya is merged into Kuala Lumpur: DOSM reports Putrajaya's GDP within W.P. Kuala Lumpur (no standalone Putrajaya GDP), so the KL tile combines KL + Putrajaya receipts (RM14.08b + RM0.94b) over KL GDP (which already includes Putrajaya).

sources.name: Domestic Tourism Survey (States) 2024 — per-state reports
sources.note: Total receipts (Jumlah Terimaan, RM million), 2024 column of each state's Key Statistics table; cross-checked against each report's prose and reconciled to the RM106.7b national total.

sources.name: GDP by State, 2024 (Table 43: GDP by state at current prices)
sources.note: Nominal / current prices, 2024p. Transcribed from the official publication workbook.

states.note: Includes W.P. Putrajaya (receipts RM14.08b KL + RM0.94b Putrajaya; GDP already includes Putrajaya per DOSM)
